description: This file contains test functions and test setup for channel search and autocomplete features in the Mattermost server, specifically testing the channel store's search capabilities with various input scenarios and configurations.

classes.name: SearchTestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for setting up and executing channel search tests, managing test context, fixtures, and verification.

methods.name: TestSearchChannelStore
methods.description: Main test function that initializes the test environment and runs a series of search tests.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByName
methods.description: Tests autocomplete functionality by channel name.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByNamePostgres
methods.description: Tests autocomplete by channel name specifically for Postgres engine.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByDisplayName
methods.description: Tests autocomplete functionality by channel display name.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByNameSplittedWithDashChar
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with channel names split by dash character.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByNameSplittedWithDashCharPostgres
methods.description: Postgres-specific test for autocomplete with dash-separated channel names.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByNameSplittedWithUnderscoreChar
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with channel names split by underscore character.

methods.name: testAutocompleteChannelByDisplayNameSplittedByWhitespaces
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with display names split by whitespace.

methods.name: testAutocompleteAllChannelsIfTermIsEmpty

methods.name: testSearchShouldSupportHavingHyphenAsLastCharacter
methods.description: Tests autocomplete with hyphen as last character in search term.
